general.title: General Settings
general.maxSessionsRange: Max sessions must be between {min} and {max}
general.threadCountInvalid: Thread count must be between {min} and {max}, or one of the listed keywords
general.tooManyIpv4NameServers: At most {max} IPv4 name servers can be configured
general.tooManyIpv6NameServers: At most {max} IPv6 name servers can be configured
general.tooManyWinsServers: At most {max} WINS servers can be configured

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Configure logging, PADO delays, limits, shaper, SNMP, and scripts.
advanced.padoDelayRequired: Every PADO delay row needs a delay
advanced.padoDelayInvalid: PADO delay {delay} must be between {min} and {max}, or disable
advanced.padoSessionsRange: PADO delay {delay}: sessions must be between {min} and {max}
advanced.padoDisableNeedsSessions: PADO delay disable needs a session count
advanced.padoOneWithoutSessions: Only one PADO delay can be set without a session count
advanced.padoAfterDisable: PADO delay {delay} has more sessions than disable
advanced.connectionLimitFormat: Connection limit {value} must be a number followed by /min or /sec (e.g. 60/sec)

auth.title: Authentication Settings
auth.localModeNeedsUser: Local mode needs at least one local user
auth.radiusModeNeedsServer: RADIUS mode needs at least one RADIUS server

pppOptions.title: PPP Options
pppOptions.minMtuRange: Min MTU must be between {min} and {max}
pppOptions.interfaceCacheRange: Interface cache must be between {min} and {max}
pppOptions.lcpEchoFailureMin: LCP echo failure must be a whole number of at least {min}
pppOptions.lcpEchoIntervalMin: LCP echo interval must be a whole number of at least {min}
pppOptions.lcpEchoTimeoutMin: LCP echo timeout must be a whole number of at least {min}
pppOptions.peerSecretRequired: Calling SID needs a peer interface ID secret
pppOptions.peerSecretIsMask: Enter the actual secret, not the mask
pppOptions.peerSecretInvalid: The secret must be {min} to {max} printable characters without spaces

radiusSettings.title: RADIUS Global Settings
radiusSettings.maxTryRange: Max try must be between {min} and {max}
radiusSettings.interimIntervalRange: Interim interval must be between {min} and {max}
radiusSettings.interimJitterRange: Interim jitter must be between {min} and {max}
radiusSettings.acctTimeoutRange: Accounting timeout must be between {min} and {max}
radiusSettings.daePortRange: DAE port must be between {min} and {max}
radiusSettings.daeKeyIsMask: Enter the actual DAE key, not the mask
radiusSettings.daeKeyRequired: A DAE server needs a DAE key

radiusServer.keyIsMask: Enter the actual key, not the mask
radiusServer.portRange: Auth port must be between {min} and {max}
radiusServer.acctPortRange: Accounting port must be between {min} and {max}
radiusServer.failTimeRange: Fail time must be between {min} and {max}

localUser.description: Configure a PPPoE local authentication user.
localUser.passwordRequired: Password is required for new users
localUser.passwordIsMask: Enter the actual password, not the mask
localUser.rateLimitBothDirections: Set both the download and upload rate limits, or neither

ipPool.description: Configure an IPv4 client address pool.
ipPool.nextPoolWithoutRange: A pool with a next pool needs at least one range

ipv6Pool.description: Configure an IPv6 client address pool.
ipv6Pool.prefixRequired: Every prefix row needs a prefix
ipv6Pool.maskRange: Prefix {prefix}: mask must be between {min} and {max}
ipv6Pool.delegateWithoutPrefix: A delegate prefix needs at least one prefix in the pool
ipv6Pool.delegatePrefixRequired: Every delegate row needs a prefix
ipv6Pool.delegationPrefixRange: Delegate {prefix}: delegation length must be between {min} and {max}
